scripts.dev: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log WRANGLER_REGISTRY_PATH=.wrangler/registry wrangler dev --var APP_ENV:local --var DEV_AUTH_SUBJECT:local-development-owner --var LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL:privacy@example.test
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: node scripts/create-cloudflare-config.mjs && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.preview:cloudflare: node scripts/create-cloudflare-config.mjs && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler versions upload --config wrangler.deploy.json
scripts.d1:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
